name: Ashgrove Linework Work Boot
description:
A classic lace-up work boot with a composite safety toe and a slip-resistant outsole rated for wet surfaces and light chemical exposure. The upper is full-grain synthetic leather with double stitching at the stress points. Ankle padding is firm but not restrictive. Available in brown and black.

Standard issue at a dozen Tier 2 job sites — electrical work, light construction, facilities maintenance. Some workers wear them off the clock too because they're simply that comfortable. Not fashionable, but not trying to be.
functionality: composite toe protection, slip and chemical-resistant sole
what_it_says: You work with your hands, you take your job seriously, and you don't dress to impress anyone.
story_hooks: A site foreman requiring Ashgroves for all crew is quietly taking a kickback from the local distributor — someone's starting to notice the markup on the safety gear budget.
A pair found at an abandoned site still has a access card tucked inside the tongue — whoever left them behind did so in a hurry.
